scenarios.title: Kantine: small talk
scenarios.tutor_role_en: a friendly colleague at lunch in the office canteen
scenarios.setting_en: Lunch in the Kantine. Talk about the weekend, the weather and the Bahn.
scenarios.goal_en: Say what you did at the weekend (Perfekt) and ask one question back.

chunks.de: Am Wochenende war ich zu Hause.
chunks.en: At the weekend I was at home.
I met a friend.
The weather was bad, unfortunately.
My train was late today.
And what did you do?

scenarios.opening_de: Hallo! Ist hier noch frei? Wie war dein Wochenende?

scenarios.title: Morning desk meeting
scenarios.tutor_role_en: the team lead running a short morning stand-up
scenarios.setting_en: Daily stand-up at the desk. Say what you worked on yesterday and what you do today.
scenarios.goal_en: Say one thing from yesterday (Perfekt) and one plan for today, with a reason (weil).

chunks.de: Gestern habe ich an einem Bericht gearbeitet.
chunks.en: Yesterday I worked on a report.

chunks.de: Heute teste ich die neue Version.
chunks.en: Today I am testing the new version.

chunks.de: Ich brauche noch etwas Zeit, weil die Daten fehlen.
chunks.en: I need a bit more time because the data is missing.
Can someone help me with it?
That is almost finished.

scenarios.opening_de: Guten Morgen! Woran hast du gestern gearbeitet?

scenarios.title: Explaining an incident from on-call
scenarios.tutor_role_en: a colleague from another team who asks about a system problem during your on-call week (generic, no real system names)
scenarios.setting_en: Coffee point. Explain what went wrong during your on-call week and what you did.
scenarios.goal_en: Tell the incident in order (zuerst, dann, danach) in the Perfekt, and say what you will change.

chunks.de: In der Nacht ist ein System ausgefallen.
chunks.en: In the night a system went down.

chunks.de: Zuerst habe ich die Logs geprüft.
chunks.en: First I checked the logs.

chunks.de: Danach haben wir den Dienst neu gestartet.
chunks.en: After that we restarted the service.

chunks.de: Der Fehler ist seitdem nicht mehr aufgetreten.
chunks.en: The error has not happened again since then.

chunks.de: Nächstes Mal würde ich früher eskalieren.
chunks.en: Next time I would escalate earlier.

scenarios.opening_de: Du hattest doch Rufbereitschaft, oder? Was ist passiert?

scenarios.title: Asking for more responsibility
scenarios.tutor_role_en: your manager in a one-to-one meeting, polite but asks for reasons
scenarios.setting_en: One-to-one with your manager. Ask for more responsibility and give reasons.
scenarios.goal_en: Ask politely with Konjunktiv II (ich würde gern, könnte ich) and give two reasons.

chunks.de: Ich würde gern mehr Verantwortung übernehmen.
chunks.en: I would like to take on more responsibility.

chunks.de: Könnte ich ein eigenes Projekt leiten?
chunks.en: Could I lead a project of my own?

chunks.de: Ich habe schon Erfahrung damit, weil ich das früher gemacht habe.
chunks.en: I already have experience with it because I did it before.
I want to develop further.
What would I need to do for that?

scenarios.opening_de: Sie wollten mit mir sprechen. Worum geht es?

scenarios.title: Doctor appointment by phone
scenarios.tutor_role_en: the receptionist at a doctor's practice on the phone
scenarios.setting_en: You call a Hausarzt practice to get an appointment.
scenarios.goal_en: Say who you are, what the problem is, and agree on a day and time.

chunks.en: I would like an appointment.

chunks.de: Ich habe seit drei Tagen Halsschmerzen.
chunks.en: I have had a sore throat for three days.

chunks.de: Haben Sie morgen Vormittag etwas frei?
chunks.en: Do you have anything free tomorrow morning?
I have public health insurance.
Can you repeat that, please?

scenarios.opening_de: Praxis Dr. Becker, guten Tag. Was kann ich für Sie tun?

scenarios.title: Deutsche Bahn: missed connection
scenarios.tutor_role_en: a staff member at the Deutsche Bahn service desk
scenarios.setting_en: Your train was late and you missed your connection. Ask for alternatives at the service desk.
scenarios.goal_en: Explain the problem, ask for the next connection, and ask if your ticket is still valid.

chunks.en: My train was late.
I missed my connection.

chunks.de: Wann fährt der nächste Zug nach Frankfurt?
chunks.en: When does the next train to Frankfurt leave?
Is my ticket still valid?

chunks.de: Von welchem Gleis fährt er ab?
chunks.en: Which platform does it leave from?

scenarios.opening_de: Guten Tag, wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?

scenarios.title: Free talk (Gupshup)
scenarios.tutor_role_en: Ustad, the teacher, in an open chat about Zee's day; asks follow-up questions
scenarios.setting_en: Open conversation about your day, your plans and your life in Germany.
scenarios.goal_en: Talk about your day. Use one weil and one verb in the Perfekt.

chunks.en: Today I worked a lot.

chunks.de: Ich bin müde, weil ich wenig geschlafen habe.
chunks.en: I am tired because I slept little.
In the evening I want to cook.
Tomorrow I have an appointment.
I find that interesting.

scenarios.opening_de: Hallo! Wie war dein Tag heute?
